source_observation: SMDATE4 002: Johnny braces legs in a wide low stance, one knee lifted and bare foot pointing down-left while other foot is planted far right. He faces left three-quarter, looking up at the load. His far hand at left holds aloft a little table with white draped cloth, red legs, yellow food on a dish and a partial red oval-backed chair behind it. The near arm extends straight to right holding another red oval-backed wooden chair by its back opening, chair tilted with legs down-right. Preserve all exact contacts and the top-heavy asymmetric composition; do not turn it into ordinary seated dining.
